text: SBI rejected my complaint about a failed ATM withdrawal of Rs 5,000 on 5 September 2026. I complained on 8 September 2026 and they replied on 20 September 2026 saying the transaction was successful. I am not satisfied.
note: Expected dates hand-computed from RB-IOS 2026 (30-day wait, 90-day window from the later of wait end and last reply).
